content: Kosonned akan Duwen Meirong
KAUN-O ketikihong Moses koasoandi pwukat
pwe mehn Israel kan en kin kapwaiada nan sahpw me e pahn ketikihong irail.

Kouwol men, sihpw wol men, sihpw men de kuht men pahn kin kak mweimweidahng KAUN-O pwehn wia meirong isihs de meirong en kapwaiada inou ehu de meirong en nsen, de meirong en warpwohmwahu, de meirong ni amwail sarawi kan. Pwohn meirong en konot pwukat kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Mehmen me pahn patohwandahng KAUN-O sihpw men de kuht men, e pahn iangahki mahno paun en pilawa riau me doalki pain riau en lehn olip pwehn wia meirong en wahnsahpw, iangahki pain riau en wain.
Ma sihpw wol men me pahn wia mehn meirong, paun pahieu en pilawa me doalki pain siluh en lehn olip me pahn meirongala pwehn wia meirong en wahnsahpw,
iangahki pain siluh en wain. Pwohn meirong pwukat kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Ma kouwol men me pahn meirongala pwehn wia meirong isihs de meirong en kapwaiada inou ehu de meirong en kaminimin,
paun weneu en pilawa me doalki pain pahieu en lehn olip me pahn wia mehn meirong en wahnsahpw,
iangahki pain pahieu en wain. Pwohn meirong pwukat kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.
Ih soahng pwukat me pahn meirongala ong emenemen kouwol, sihpw wol, sihpw de kuht eh pahn meirongala.
Ni ahnsou me mahn tohtohsang emen me pahn meirongala, dipwisou me pahn iang emenemen mahn pahn duweduwehte ong emenemen mahn ako.
Mehn Israel koaros pahn kin wia met, ni arail pahn kin wia meirong en konot, pwowe kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O.

Ahpw ahnsou koaros me mehn liki men me kin koukousoan rehmwail, mehnda ma ahnsou mwotomwot de reirei, me pahn wia meirong en konot, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O, e pahn pil kapwaiada soangen koasoandiohte.
Sang met kohla koasoandi pwukat kin manaman ong kumwail oh ong mehn liki kan me kin kousoan rehmwail. Pwe kumwail oh irail soangen pahrekte ieu mwohn silangin KAUN-O.
Soangen kosonned oh koasoandi koaros kin doakedoake kumwail oh pil irail.
KAUN-O ketikihong Moses
koasoandi pwukat pwe mehn Israel ko en kin kapwaiada nan sahpw me e pahn ketikihong irail.
Ni amwail pahn kin tungoale wahnsahpwo, kumwail pahn kin katohrehsang ekis pwehn wia mehn kisakis kesempwal ehu ong KAUN-O.

Ni ahnsou me kumwail pahn umwun pilawa, keieun lopwon sang ni wahn pilawa kapw pahn wia mehn kisakis kesempwal ehu ong KAUN-O. Met pahn meirongala duwehte kisakis kesempwal me kumwail kin wia ni meirong en wahnsahpw sang amwail wasahn koadoahki wahnsahpw.
Sang met kohla soangen kisakis kesempwal wet pahn kin wiawihong KAUN-O sang pilawa me kumwail pahn kin umwun.
Ahpw ma emen depweila oh sohte kapwaiada ehu koasoandi pwukat me KAUN-O ketikihong Moses,
oh ma sang met kohla mehn Israel koaros sohte kapwaiada mehkoaros me KAUN-O mahsanihong Moses pwe en padahkihong irail.

Ma sapwung wet wiawi pwehki ar sohte wehwehki, eri re pahn meirongkihla emen kouwol nin duwen meirong isihs, me pwowe kin kaparanda kupwur en KAUN-O, iangahki meirong en wahnsahpw oh wain me kin wiawi. Re pil pahn kapatahiong emen kuht wol mehn wia meirong en dihp.

Samworo ahpw pahn wia sarawien kamwakele mehn Israel koaros, oh diparailo ahpw pahn lapwada, pwehki ar depweikihla sapwung wet oh re patohwandahr ar meirong en dihp nin duwen meirong isihs ong KAUN-O.
Mehn Israel koaros iangahki mehn liki kan me kin kousoan rehrail pahn ale lapwepen diparailo, pwehki irail koaros iang pwukoahkihdi sapwung wet.
Ahpw ma aramas emen me depweikihla dihp ehu, e pahn meirongki kuht lih men me sounpar ehu nin duwen meirong en dihp.
Samworo ahpw pahn wia sarawien kamwakel mwohn silangin KAUN-O ni pei sarawio, dipen aramaso ahpw pahn lapwada.
Soangen koasoandihteieu doake koaros me pahn depweikihla dihp ehu, mehnda ma ih mehn Israel men de mehn liki men me kin kousoan rehmwail.
Ahpw aramas emen sohte lipilipil, mehn Israel de mehn liki, me dipada sang ni pein insene, e milahr nan dipen mwamwahliki KAUN-O, eri e pahn kamakamala,
pwehki eh soikala kosonned en KAUN-O oh kauwehla ehu sapwellime koasoandi kan. E pahn pein pwukoahki eh mehla.
Ohl emen me Kauwehla Kosonned en Sapad.
Nindokon mehn Israel kan ar koukousoan nan sapwtehn, ohl emen ahpw dierekda eh wesewesei tuwi ni rahnen Sapad.
E ahpw pakahrdo rehn Moses, Aaron oh rehn mehn Israel ko koaros,
re ahpw kihong nan imweteng, pwehki ar sehse dahme re pahn wiahiong.
KAUN-O eri mahsanihong Moses, “Aramas menet pahn kamakamala; mehn Israel koaros pahn katehki takai likin kahnimpwalo e lao mehla.”
Mehn Israel koaros ahpw kahreieila ohlo likin kahnimpwalo oh katehki takai e lao mehla duwen KAUN-O e mahsanihong Moses.
Koasoandi Duwen Pengkir mehn Kataman ni Ar Likou kan
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses
en patohwanohng mehn Israel kan, “Kumwail wiahda pengkir mehn kataman ni pwungipen amwail likou kan oh kihong kisin sahl poh mei ni ehuehu mehn kataman kan. Met pahn wiawi sang met kohkohlahte.
Mehn kataman pwukat pahn katamankin kumwail ei kosonned koaros pwe kumwail dehr kin sohpeisang ie oh idawehn ineng en nan kapehdamwail kan.
Mehn kataman pwukat pahn kin katamankin kumwail en kapwaiada ei kosonned koaros; eri kumwail pahn wiahla nei aramas.
Ngehi, KAUN-O amwail Koht, me kahreikumwaildo sang Isip pwe I en wiahla amwail Koht. Ngehi KAUN-O.”
